method.segment_definition: Classify each GPX edge: UNKNOWN for time gaps/jumps or missing original gom:speed at either endpoint; STOP only for stationary episodes >=120s with nonmissing speed; SEARCH_MOTION_CANDIDATE otherwise, but NEVER automatically Negative.
method.unit_of_output: temporal intervals and point-index ranges; source GPX 0-based trackpoint index; never interpolate across gaps.

nights.method: Identical stop candidates and 100m/10min source matches; plus UNKNOWN_SOURCE_SPEED whenever either interval endpoint lacks original gom:speed.
